name: youtube-video-strategy
description:
Produces a YouTube video strategy document with title formulas, thumbnail
concept specification, description template with timestamps, and tag list
for a specific video topic. Use when the user asks to optimize a YouTube
video for discovery, plan a YouTube upload, create a thumbnail concept,
or write a video description.
Do NOT use for writing the actual video script (use video-script-writing),
creating a shot list (use video-storyboard), or planning short-form
vertical video (use short-form-video-planning).
